items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, Cantrell was the snare drum player with the Excelsis, see? Mm-hmm. Every time he'd, he'd give me the signal with that, with his stick that made me know how to hit that drum.

ctx.x: Yeah, Cantrell was the snare drum player with the Excelsis, see? Mm-hmm. Every time he'd, he'd give me the signal with that, with his stick that made me know how to hit that drum. Mm-hmm. You see? And I'd like to have to play bass drum that way, on the Cantrell.
Did he teach you to read music at all? No.
